initialExam.title: MPSC Rajyaseva (State Services) 2026
initialExam.description: MPSC Rajyaseva exam for Group A and Group B administrative posts in Maharashtra state government. 79 vacancies notified for 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university. Marathi proficiency required.
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation in any discipline + Marathi proficiency
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS Paper I (100Q, 200 marks) + CSAT Paper II (80Q, 200 marks, qualifying). Mains: Marathi & English, GS I-IV, Essay, Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers, objective. Mains: 6 papers (descriptive) + Interview (275 marks). Total Mains: 800 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Tahsildar, BDO, Deputy Registrar
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → Additional Collector → District Collector → Divisional Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mpsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, Government quarters

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
